Back-off restarting failed container read-config

Args: curl ... --header "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token)" ... /configmaps/app-config

Evidence showed `config-reader` was running, yet had no authorization at all: `kubectl -n default get role,rolebinding` listed only the empty `Role/app-config-reader` and its predecessor RoleBinding had been removed from the server (`NotFound`). kind: Role; metadata.namespace: default; name: app-config-reader
rules: [{apiGroups: [""]}] resources: ["configmaps"] verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]; scope: Namespaced

kind: RoleBinding; metadata.name: app-config-reader-binding; namespace: default
subjects: [{kind: ServiceAccount, name: config-reader, namespace: default}]
roleRef: [{kind: Role, name: app-config-reader, namespace: default}]
